highlights.title: Safer backups and saving
highlights.description: Invalid backups leave your records untouched. Restore asks before replacing records, and saving in two windows keeps both changes.

highlights.title: More accurate leave balances
highlights.description: Balances follow the correct leave year. Comp-Off leave uses credits that are valid for the selected dates.

highlights.title: Clearer calendar and settings
highlights.description: Both half-day sessions appear in Calendar, past bookings show Taken consistently, and custom cycle dates stay as saved.

releaseNotes: Safer restore and saving, accurate leave-year balances and Comp-Off checks, and consistent calendar details. Older records keep their saved totals and leave types.
